meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

auth.review_note: Compared the shared backend skill and mail change with account lifecycle guidance. Ordinary verified signup and password recovery retain their original event and queue paths.

mail.review_note: Checked the reconciled AdminController change in product editing. Mail defaults, rendering and queue behavior remain as documented.

media.review_note: Checked shared admin UI guidance and product validation. Media reference ownership and reviewed deletion remain as documented.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed product tax edits, Reports help, checkout-email account help and the reconciled admin layout. Unit fields and historical review rules match the forms and exports.

public-mcp.review_note: Checked the shared remote documentation against the public MCP checkout projection. Unit options remain private catalogue and invoice metadata.

remote-commerce.review_note: Compared private quote, digest and verified-order snapshots with the remote flow and documented the optional canonical unit pair.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed the optional canonical catalogue fields against the merchant feed projection. Published product, price and inventory fields remain as documented.

workflow.review_note: Checked the added synthetic browser regression and reconciled documentation against the existing CI, owner-only QA and release workflows.
